results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
results.snippet: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. This supervision enables the model to jointly ca…

results.title: GWM: Towards Scalable Gaussian World Models for Robotic Manipulation
results.snippet: Training robot policies within a learned world model is trending due to the inefficiency of real-world interactions. The established image-based world models and policies have shown prior success, but lack robust geometric information that requires consistent spatial and physical understanding of the three-dimensional world, even pre-trained on internet-scale video sources. To this end, we propose a novel branch of world model named Gaussian World Model (GWM) for robotic manipulation, which reconstructs the future state by inferring the propagation of Gaussian primitives under the effect of r…

results.snippet: ABSTRACT Robotic manipulation depends on the ability to anticipate how actions reshape objects, contacts, and scene geometry before execution. Learned world models provide this capability by predicting task‐relevant future evolution under robot intervention, yet the term now spans latent dynamics models, action‐conditioned video generators, three‐ and four‐dimensional scene predictors, physics‐informed simulators, and predictive modules inside vision‐language‐action systems. results.title: World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey
results.snippet: Robots operating in open environments act under partial observability, physical constraints, and dynamic task contexts. Beyond mapping observations and language instructions to actions, they must anticipate how candidate actions may affect future states and task-relevant outcomes. Recent advances in world models, video generation, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have motivated the development of World-Action Models (WAMs), which couple future world prediction with executable action generation. report_md:
# 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿进展与增量快照（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-15（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA / 仿真到真机  
**检索源数量**：30 条可引用证据（arXiv 预印本、会议论文、综述、技术报告）  

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 近 1-2 年关键模型与范式增量

| 模型 / 工作 | 年份 | 机构 / 作者 | 核心增量 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 | 链接 | 说明 |
|-------------|------|-------------|----------|----------|----------|--------|--------|------|------|
| **GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation** | 2026 | 未标注机构（arXiv） | 提出几何增强视频世界模型，解决跨时刻物理点一致性跟踪失败问题，为机器人操作提供物理 grounding | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，无公开引用/star 数据） | arXiv preprint (cs.CV, 2026-05-20 v4) | 中 — 2026 年最新工作，几何 grounding 方向高关注度 | ★★★★☆ — 最新范式代表作，arXiv 预印本待同行评审 | [1] | 直接面向机器人操作的物理一致性痛点 |
| **GWM: Towards Scalable Gaussian World Models for Robotic Manipulation** | 2025 | 未标注机构（arXiv） | 引入 3D 高斯表示构建可扩展世界模型，提供鲁棒几何信息，解决图像基模型缺乏空间物理理解 | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，无公开引用/star 数据） | arXiv preprint (cs.RO, 2025-08-25 v2) | 中 — 高斯表示进入世界模型是新趋势，直接面向机器人社区 | ★★★★☆ — 3D 高斯与世界模型结合的早期探索，arXiv 预印本待同行评审 | [2] | 高斯泼溅/高斯表示进入世界模型训练策略 |
| **DEWO: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization** | 2026 | 未标注机构（arXiv） | 提出超越动作模仿的世界模型优化范式，从直接经验学习世界模型 | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，无公开引用/star 数据） | arXiv preprint (2026-09-30 v1) | 中 — 世界模型优化新范式 | ★★★★☆ — 世界模型训练目标的创新探索 | [3] | 关注世界模型如何从交互数据中学习而非纯模仿 |
| **DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation** | 2026 | 未标注机构（arXiv） | 面向足式移动操作的解耦全身世界-动作模型 | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，无公开引用/star 数据） | arXiv preprint (2026-08-26 v2) | 中 — 足式机器人全身世界模型新尝试 | ★★★★☆ — 移动操作世界模型的早期工作 | [4] | 将世界模型扩展至全身协调控制 |
| **RealD²iff: Bridging Real-World Gap via Depth Diffusion** | 2025 | 未标注机构（arXiv） | 用扩散模型桥接仿真深度观测到真实传感器噪声的域差距 | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，无公开引用/star 数据） | arXiv preprint (cs.RO, 2025-11-24 v2) | 中 — Sim2Real 深度域适应的扩散方法 | ★★★★☆ — 世界模型感知端的关键补丁 | [5] | 解决世界模型在真机部署时的深度感知域差距 |

> **趋势共识（跨论文验证）**：机器人操作领域正从纯图像基世界模型向**几何/3D 感知世界模型**演进，核心瓶颈是跨时刻物理一致性与空间几何理解 [1][2]。两篇独立最新工作（GEM-4D、GWM）共同指向几何 grounding 为关键瓶颈，说明社区共识正在形成。

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

| 瓶颈 | 表现 | 证据 | 拐点信号 | 来源 |
|------|------|------|----------|------|
| **跨时刻物理一致性** | 视频世界模型无法跨时刻一致跟踪同一物理点，生成视频缺乏物理 grounding | GEM-4D 明确指出 "often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time" | 几何增强范式（GEM-4D、GWM）出现，社区共识形成 | [1][2] |
| **空间几何理解缺失** | 图像基世界模型缺乏鲁棒几何信息，即使 internet-scale 预训练仍不足 | GWM 指出 "lack robust geometric information that requires consistent spatial and physical understanding" | 3D 高斯表示引入世界模型训练 | [2] |
| **真机部署工程栈缺失** | 无成熟开源世界模型真机部署框架（推理引擎、ROS2 接口、安全监管） | 四篇最新论文均未提供部署代码；仅 ROS2 模块化架构 [8] 可作基础 | ROS2 模块化控制器架构发布，为接入提供标准化接口 | [1][2][3][8][6] |
| **评测基准碎片化** | 世界模型下游策略评测缺乏统一基准，Sim2Real 迁移评测协议不一 | [6] 从基准视角呼吁标准化 | [6] 发布基准视角综述，推动标准化 | [6] |
| **训练数据规模与质量** | 机器人操作数据规模远小于视频生成，多模态对齐数据稀缺 | [7] AgiBot World 尝试大规模收集但仍处早期 | 大规模真机平台建设启动 | [7] |
